jobs.description:
HEMFRID SÖKER STOR- OCH FLYTTSTÄDARE I HELSINGBORG – BLI EN DEL AV VÅRT TEAM!
Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, fönsterputs och andra tjänster i hemmet, alltid med kvalitet och omtanke.
Nu söker vi dig som vill arbeta som stor- och flyttstädare i vårt OneTime team i Helsingborg. Hos oss blir du en del av ett internationellt team med kollegor från hela världen, tillsammans levererar vi service i världsklass!
Vad erbjuder vi? 
· En tjänst på 75% i sysselsättningsgrad
· Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor 
· Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad 
· Milersättning mellan kunder för dig som kör egen bil i tjänst 
· Betalt restid mellan kunderna 
· Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension) 
· Vi värnar om din hälsa! Därför erbjuder vi ett friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år 
· Gratis mobilabonnemang 
· Kostnadsfri utbildning i hemstädning samt vidareutbildningar inom service och städning 
· Field Lead/Buddy – kontaktperson inom städning samt stöd till medarbetare ute på fältet 
· Teamträffar och gemensamma fester 
Vi letar efter dig som:

Tycker om att jobba i team med andra kollegor

Ha tidigare erfarenhet inom städning

Är engagerad och vill utvecklas inom städning

Pratar svenska eller engelska

Kunna arbeta flexibla timmar

Har B-körkort

Det är starkt meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat som hemstädare, hushållerska eller motsvarande.
Som Stor- och Flyttstädare arbetar man ofta i grupp, möter nya kunder och miljöer varje dag och är trygg i att ta ansvar för både utförande och slutbedömning av städningen.
Vår process
Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller. För att vara kvalificerad för den här tjänsten behöver du ha ett svenskt personnummer eller ett samordningsnummer.
Ansök redan idag! Läs mer på www.hemfrid.se/karriar och ansök  Har du frågor? Kontakta oss gärna på hr@hemfrid.se
Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! ✨
HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR DEEP CLEANERS AND MOVE-OUT CLEANERS IN HELSINGBORG – JOIN OUR TEAM!
Hemfrid is Sweden’s largest home cleaning company. We help our customers with cleaning, window cleaning, and other home services – always with quality and care.
We are now looking for you who want to work as a Deep Cleaner / Move-out Cleaner in our OneTime team in Helsingborg. With us, you will become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world, together delivering world-class service!
What do we offer?

A 75% position

Collective agreement and secure employment conditions

Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month

Mileage compensation between customers if you use your own car for work

Paid travel time between customers

Insurance (health, liability, and occupational pension)

We care about your health! That’s why we offer a wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year

Free mobile phone subscription

Free training in home cleaning and further education in service and cleaning

Field Lead/Buddy – a contact person and support for employees in the field

Team meetings and social events

We are looking for someone who:

Enjoys working in a team with other colleagues

Has previous experience in cleaning

Is committed and wants to develop within cleaning

Speaks Swedish or English

Can work flexible hours

Holds a Category B driver’s license and access to a car

Previous experience as a home cleaner, housekeeper, or similar is highly meritorious.
As a Deep Cleaning and Move-Out Cleaner, you often work in teams, meet new customers and environments every day, and are confident in taking responsibility for both the execution and final quality assessment of the cleaning.
Our process
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks. To be eligible for this position, you need to have a Swedish personal identity number or coordination number.
Apply today! ✨
Read more and apply at www.hemfrid.se/karriar If you have questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se
We look forward to hearing from you!

· En timanställning
· Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor
· Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad

· Betalt restid mellan kunderna
· Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension)

HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR CLEANERS IN MJÖLBY – JOIN OUR TEAM!
Do you want a job where you truly make a difference in people’s everyday lives?
Hemfrid is Sweden’s largest home cleaning company. We help our customers with cleaning, window cleaning, and other home services – always with quality and care.
We are now looking for you who want to work as a cleaner in Mjölby. With us, you will become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world. Together, we deliver world-class service!
What do we offer?
· An hourly employment
· Collective agreement and secure employment terms
· Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month
· Mileage compensation between customers if you use your own car for work
· Paid travel time between customers
· Insurance (health, liability, and occupational pension)
· We care about your health! That’s why we offer a wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year
· Free mobile phone subscription
· Free training in home cleaning and further education in service and cleaning
· Field Lead/Buddy – point of contact and support for team members in the field on cleaning operations.
· Team meetings and social events
With us, you get the right conditions to succeed. If you have the motivation, we will give you the tools to excel!
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who:
· Enjoys working both independently and in a team
· Is detail-oriented, responsible, and committed
· Wants to grow and develop
· Speaks Swedish or English
· Can work flexible hours (Monday–Friday between 08:00–17:00)
· Is flexible and enjoys working with different customers
Requirements:
· B driver’s license and access to your own car
Meritorious:
· Experience in cleaning or service-related jobs
Apply today! Read more at www.hemfrid.se/karriar and apply  If you have questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se
We look forward to hearing from you! ✨

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for fundamental research using neutrons. The ILL operates the brightest neutron source in the world and hosts over 2000 visits by scientists per year, who come to carry out world-class research.
Within the Applied Science group (AS, 18 people) of ILL's Science Division, you will act as instrument technician for the new ThRILL thermal neutron imaging instrument, which will enter user operation in 2027, and TENIS, an irradiation instrument serving academic and industrial needs.

Your tasks:
In this context, you will:
- Ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of ThRILL and TENIS, which are located in building ILL5, level C, at the reactor neutron source.
- Coordinate the work of ILL services involved in these activities.
- Assist the ILL scientists responsible for ThRILL and TENIS with the preparation and conducting of experiments, typically together with scientific and industrial users.
- Propose technical improvements and, where appropriate, implement these improvements with the assistance of ILL services.
-Help to ensure compliance with ILL and instrument safety regulations, in particular radiation protection regulations.
-Become a valued member of the Applied Science group and support your colleagues and users where needed and appropriate.

Your profile:
- You have a Level 4-6 qualification (e.g. BTEC HNC/HND, undergraduate degree or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, applied physics and instrumentation or equivalent.
-You have at least two years of professional experience in the same area.
-You have experience in the manufacture, assembly and alignment of precision mechanical, electronic and optical assemblies.
-You are proficient in the use of CAD software.
-Ideally, you also have some knowledge of computing, electronics and electricity to allow you to take part in other technical projects.
-You have a practical approach to your work and are keen to learn new skills.
-You are an excellent team player but are also capable of working independently on a wide variety of projects.
- You are able to work meticulously and provide support to in-house and visiting scientists.

What we offer:
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more information, please visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-condition

 Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced Workplace Technology Technical Lead is needed for a consulting assignment within a large organisation operating a complex IT environment. The role provides technical leadership for the digital workplace, Microsoft 365, client platforms and mobile devices. The assignment focuses on driving sustainable technical development and improvements that enhance productivity, user experience, stability and security.
You will work closely with business stakeholders, internal IT teams, suppliers and global IT functions. This is a technical leadership and advisory role with significant influence over technical direction, strategic choices and the long-term evolution of workplace technology. The role does not include day-to-day operations or operational delivery; instead, it complements existing suppliers and global governance functions without assuming their delivery, budget or resource responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities
Set and drive the technical direction for workplace technology, including developing, anchoring and following up a technical roadmap with dependencies, risks and agreed actions.
Identify improvement opportunities and recommend priorities to reduce technical debt and complexity while improving productivity, automation and user experience.
Lead technical analyses and risk assessments for investments and changes, producing recommendations and reviewing decision material based on business impact, security, supportability, cost and user value.
Define requirements for, challenge and follow up supplier and global IT team technical commitments, quality and documentation in collaboration with contract, service and delivery owners.
Represent business needs and the user perspective in CAB, Global CAB and other relevant decision-making forums.
Provide technical support during major incidents, problem investigations and complex changes, and recommend sustainable long-term corrective actions.
Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge transfer and internal capability development, working with ITSM stakeholders on lifecycle management.
Act as a technical advisor to internal IT functions and relevant service and decision owners.
Make technical decisions within defined frameworks and delegated authority, clearly communicating recommendations, risks, alternatives and required decision conditions.
Recommend additional analysis, conditions, postponement or escalation when decision material or risk management is insufficient.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Deep knowledge of Microsoft Intune, endpoint management, Windows client platforms and mobile device management.
Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 and the interaction between productivity, collaboration, endpoint and security capabilities.
Experience with technical governance, architecture principles, standardisation and lifecycle management.
Experience with established IT service management processes, including incident, problem and change management.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365 capabilities for security, collaboration and information management.
Experience with automation, analytics and proactive monitoring within the endpoint and digital workplace domain.
Exposure to licence optimisation, cost management, service follow-up, change management and user adoption.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate has several years of experience in technical leadership within digital workplace technology, client management or Microsoft 365 in a complex organisation. You should have experience of supplier governance, requirements management and follow-up of external and global deliveries, as well as the ability to translate business requirements into sustainable, secure and manageable technical solutions.
Experience from large, distributed or global organisations with substantial user populations and complex dependencies is required. A relevant Microsoft certification, or equivalent documented competence, is advantageous. The role requires an analytical and structured approach, the ability to prioritise complex dependencies and confidence in advising and guiding technical decisions without formal personnel responsibility.
Location
This is a consulting assignment for a large organisation with a complex and potentially global IT environment. Professional fluency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written, is required.

Job Description
Your contribution to something big

jobs.occupation: We seek nurses for permanent positions in Snåsa in Norway
jobs.description:
Would you like a permanent nursing position with varied responsibilities and nature right outside your door?
On behalf of Snåsa Municipality in Trøndelag, Norway, we are seeking three registered nurses for permanent positions within the municipal healthcare and care services.
Here, you will enjoy a varied and meaningful workday, providing care and follow-up for patients both in home care services and in institutional settings. You will become part of a professional healthcare environment where nurses play a key role, with a high degree of autonomy, varied clinical responsibilities, and close collaboration with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
At the same time, you will have the opportunity to live in a place where nature is never far away. Snåsa is located next to the Blåfjella-Skjækerfjella National Park, offering vast forests, mountains, and excellent opportunities for hiking, cycling, hunting, and fishing. With a population of approximately 2,100 people, Snåsa is also a welcoming community where it is easy to get to know people and feel at home.
About the position
As a Registered Nurse, you will have a varied workday caring for patients with different needs in both home care services and institutional care settings.
Typical responsibilities include:
Providing daily nursing care and professional follow-up to patients in home care services and/or institutional care
Observing, assessing, and documenting patients’ health conditions
Medication administration and treatment in accordance with applicable guidelines and regulations
Collaborating with other healthcare professionals, family members, and multidisciplinary teams
Contributing to quality improvement initiatives and the development of local routines and patient care pathways

The position involves shift work, including day, evening, and weekend shifts. You will have a significant level of professional responsibility and will work both independently and closely with other professional groups. High-quality, safe patient care is at the heart of everything, while maintaining a positive working environment built on collaboration, well-being, and good humor.
Qualifications
We are looking for someone who is professionally engaged, responsible, and enjoys working both independently and as part of a team.
Authorization as a registered nurse in an EU or EEA country
Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Norwegian
Valid police clearance and health certificate including tuberculosis and MRSA before starting
Valid driver’s licence (Class B)
Professionally engaged and responsible
Strong teamwork and adaptability skills
Experience from elderly care, home care services, or rehabilitation is an advantage

We offer
Permanent employment with competitive terms and conditions
Free Norwegian language training provided
A stable and predictable working environment
Varied and meaningful nursing responsibilities
A supportive and collaborative team environment, including guidance when needed
Excellent opportunities for professional development and continuing education
Attractive municipal pension and insurance schemes through KLP
Additional compensation for evening, night, and weekend work
Support and follow-up from Dignus Medical throughout the application and employment process
Support with housing and relocation when needed

Life in Snåsa
Snåsa is located in the northern part of Trøndelag, along the E6 highway and the Nordland Railway, approximately 50 minutes from Steinkjer. The municipality has around 2,100 residents and is ideal for those who wish to live close to nature while being part of a small and welcoming community. The area offers an active sports and cultural scene, shops, cafés, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities all year round.
For those relocating with family, the municipality offers good capacity in kindergartens, schools, and after-school programs, as well as a variety of leisure activities for children and families. Trondheim Airport Værnes is approximately two hours away by car, and the Nordland Railway also provides convenient transportation to and from Snåsa.
Interested?
Feel free to contact us for more information or submit a short application today!

And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

What we’re looking for
12+ years of experience designing and launching campaigns that get talked about.
You're based in Stockholm, or ready to be.
You've built or shaped a brand inside an early stage or high-growth tech company where the category is still being defined and the roadmap moves fast.
You've led European brand campaigns end to end — strategy, brief, production, launch — across more than one market.
Working relationships with European creative talent and with media agencies you can call on day one.
You've written briefs that shipped great work, and you can show them.

What you’ll do

Work with brand design to build and steward brand systems that keep Lovable consistent and distinct as we scale.
Be the HQ champion for the brand, helping to educate teams across the company on how to best represent and embody the brand in all decisions.
Measure brand health and creative effectiveness and use those insights to continuously sharpen strategy and creative.
Conduct culture research, study human behavior, and uncover deep emotional insights to drive creative and campaign strategy.
Write beautifully structured briefs that define for creative teams the exact story the brand needs to tell in a particular campaign.
Set direction for where and how the campaign should show up (e.g., experiential pop-ups, TV spots, social, etc) with an emphasis on doing the unexpected whenever possible.
Orchestrate integrated campaigns, ensuring marketing channel owners understand the story, timeline, and goals are met or exceeded.
Direct global agency partners on awareness media buying.

jobs.occupation: Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness
jobs.description:
Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness
About the role
We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented Manager – Programs, Projects & Product Cost Competitiveness to lead and develop a team of five Program and Project Managers.
This role combines people leadership, program execution, and cost competitiveness. You will ensure that key development, industrialization, improvement, and transformation initiatives are delivered with clear ownership, strong execution, and measurable business impact.
A central part of the role is driving our Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VAVE) agenda, identifying and implementing opportunities to reduce product and manufacturing costs while maintaining or improving quality, reliability, and customer value.
You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, and Finance to turn business priorities into successful programs and projects.
Key responsibilities
Lead the Program & Project Management organization
Lead, coach, and develop a team of five Program and Project Managers.
Establish effective ways of working, governance, and project management standards.
Ensure projects are prioritized, resourced, and executed according to business needs.
Support teams in managing risks, resolving issues, and improving project performance.
Drive a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Program Management & Strategic Execution
Translate business strategy into executable programs and projects.
Maintain program and project roadmaps and manage priorities and dependencies.
Ensure projects are aligned with strategic and financial objectives.
Monitor progress, risks, resources, costs, and expected benefits.
Provide transparent reporting and facilitate timely decision-making.

Drive VAVE & Cost Competitiveness
Establish and lead a structured VAVE process across products and manufacturing.
Identify and prioritize cost-reduction opportunities with measurable business impact.
Lead cross-functional workshops and initiatives involving Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Quality, and Finance.
Drive Design-to-Cost and Design-for-Manufacturing activities.
Build and maintain a pipeline of cost-saving initiatives and ensure benefits are tracked and realized.
Verify savings together with Finance while safeguarding quality, reliability, and customer requirements.

Cross-functional Leadership
Build strong collaboration across functions.
Drive fact-based decision-making and root-cause problem solving.
Challenge existing solutions and encourage continuous improvement.
Ensure focus on speed, simplicity, and execution.

Hands-on Leadership
While primarily a leadership role, you will also take personal ownership of selected strategic and complex initiatives, including major transformation programs and critical VAVE projects.
Leadership expectations
We are looking for a leader who:
Takes ownership and delivers results.
Creates momentum and drives execution.
Makes decisions based on facts and business priorities.
Holds teams accountable while building trust and engagement.
Communicates clearly and effectively across the organization.
Leads through influence and develops people and capabilities.

Success in the role requires the ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Qualifications
Required
Several years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Engineering, Operations, or a related industrial environment.
Proven track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives.
Experience managing and developing people.
Strong knowledge of project and program management methodologies.
Experience with cost-reduction, VAVE, Design-to-Cost, or similar initiatives.
Strong business and financial understanding.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Fluent in Swedish and English.

Preferred
Experience from manufacturing industries.
Engineering or technical university degree.
Experience with product development and industrialization.
Knowledge of Lean, continuous improvement, or operational excellence.
Experience with manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacturing/Assembly.
Familiarity with ERP, PLM, MES, or project management systems.
Project or Program Management certification.

Personal profile
You combine strong leadership capability, technical understanding, and business acumen. You are:
Results-oriented and structured.
Hands-on and action-focused.
Commercially minded and analytical.
Collaborative and influential.
Confident in challenging the status quo.
Decisive and comfortable driving change.

Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality and are motivated by turning opportunities into measurable business results.
Our mission
Lead people, programs, and projects that transform business priorities into measurable results while continuously improving the competitiveness and profitability of our products and operations through VAVE.
